_comment: Single source of truth for what the membership delivers. Read by config.py (licensing), product_files.py (private hosting) and sales-site/build.py (/setup). NinjaTrader product IDs are the vendor-portal IDs. The product files are proprietary and NEVER committed (this repository is public): an admin uploads them at /admin/products, they're stored in the app's database and served at download_url only to signed-in members with an active paid membership. sha256 must match.
